name: OMathRecognizedFunction
description: Represents a recognized function. The OMathRecognizedFunction object is a member of the OMathRecognizedFunctions collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathRecognizedFunction object.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the position of an item in a collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the name of an equation recognized function. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified recognized function from the list of the recognized functions.
